labeled_by: Claude Code session, 2026-09-29; not yet reviewed by a person
how_to_read: Each item is a location in a real tracked CARR file, found by `anchor` (the exact text of one line; `occurrence` picks the Nth match) and gold-labelled for some of jev_code_review.QUESTIONS. `labels` are scored; `disputed` questions are excluded from both sides with the reason. A question not named is unlabelled for that item and never scored.

items.rationale: A corrupt manifest.json returns None, the same as a missing one; the caller then prints 'NO BASELINE ... nothing to compare against yet' and skips the tamper comparison. A corruption silently disables the tamper check under a message that names a different cause. The exists() then read gap is caught by the except, so it is not a race bug.
Unreadable corpus-set returns an empty exclusion set with no trace; the cost is double-reporting files another script watches, which is louder, not quieter.

items.anchor: return [p.strip() for p in parts if str(p).strip()]
items.rationale: A None element passes the str(p).strip() guard as 'None' and then p.strip() raises AttributeError: the guard admits the input it exists to reject.
A NULL reason becomes the string 'None', passes the not-blank guard, and the receipt is accepted as Joe-bound with no reason.

items.anchor: words = [re.escape(t) for t in pack.get("triggers", []) if str(t).strip()]
items.rationale: A null trigger passes the guard and re.escape(None) raises.

items.rationale: A lead with co=None is counted as a county named 'None'.
